tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i khrid 'chad par tho yig gnad kyi lde mig ces bya ba bzhugs so// swa sti/ dpal e waṃ chos ldan gyi gtsug lag khang chen por lam 'bras 'chad pa'i phyag len gyi tho la/ bla ma dam pa'i drung du lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i dbang khrid man ngag lung dang bcas pa sgrub pa lung sbyin gyi bar legs par thob nas chag med kyi rim pa thun gnyis nyams su len pa'i sgo nas snyan brgyud bzhi dang ldan pas gzhi'i bsnyen pa las su rung ba'i sbyin sreg dang bcas pa grub pa'i rdo rje slob dpon gyis/ bla ma'i bka'i gnang ba thob pa'am/ dngos su bka' rgyas btab pa thim pa'i dus sam/ bka' rgya dngos su med na yang gzhan gyis gsol ba btab pas rten 'brel 'grig pa'i dus su gzhan la ston pa'i tshul la/ snang gsum gyi skabs su chos gtor ni mi dgos/ 'khrid 'dzugs pa dgong mo nas mdzad cing / grol ba snga dro nas mdzad pa phyag len yin pas gza' skar bzang po yod par 'grigs na bla ma gong ma'i dus chen yod pa zhig la 'dzugs/ de nyin nas brtsams te snang gsum gyi rigs la/ chos rim mdzad tshul ni/ khri thog tu phebs bstun chos kyi gaṇ+ḍe bskul nas/ grwa pa snga ma gang 'tshogs la chos khrims pas gzings chos bkye/ shog bu gcig klog zin pa dang mnyam du chos khrims pas chos bsdus la/ dbu mdzad kyis smra bsam brjod med sogs sh+lo ka gcig dang / 'di skad bdag gis thos pa sogs/ mdo sgrub tshar gcig bdud bzlog tshar gsum/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs sh+lo ka gcig bgegs rigs stong phrag sogs sh+lo gcig dpal ldan lha mo sogs sh+lo gcig oṃ na mo bha ga wa te sarba trai lo kya sogs/ rnam rgyal ma'i gzungs tshar gcig oṃ a mṛ te sogs tshar gcig dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma sogs sh+lo ka gcig a la la te sogs tshar gcig dpal ldan khyod kyi yon tan dran sogs sh+lo ka gcig

srid pa'i 'khri shing drwa ba bral mdzad cing sogs nas 'jug par shog ces pa'i bar tshar gsum/ shes bya kun la legs sbyangs sogs sh+lo ka gcig dang sbrel la sde snod gsum gyi chu klung kun 'du'i mtsho/ zhes pa nas mkha' 'gro'i dbang por byin gyis rlobs/ skye ba kun tu sogs sh+lo ka gcig khyod la bstod cing sogs sh+lo ka gcig rnams mdzad do/ /'di dag ni dpal ye waṃ chos ldan du rje btsun rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po nyid kyis mdzad pa'i bsgrigs rim bla ma brgyud pa thams cad kyi phyag len chag med yin/ rjes gnang mi mdzad dus chos rim rdzogs pa 'phral mchod g.yog pas maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba zhu/ zhes bskul la maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun ma tshar gcig phul/ 'di las bsgrigs 'don mi mdzad/ chu med par skam 'bul byed pa phyag len yin/ 'di rnams snang gsum gyi skabs thams cad du bya ba yin/ nyi ma dang po la ri khrod lo ma can gyi rjes gnang sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i 'ching dang mthun par mdzad/ nyi ma gnyis pa'i snga dro chos rim sngar bzhin grub nas/ maṇ+ḍal phul chos spyod kyi rim pa'i lung rnams mang nyung ci rigs btang / dgong mo 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na sogs rjes gnang gang rung mdzad/ de bzhin du nyi ma bzhi lnga'i bar snga gro chos spyod skor sogs kyi lung dang dgong mo rjes gnang re mdzad nas nyi ma drug bdun gang rung gi dmigs pa 'dzugs/ thugs brel dang bstun dgos kyi rjes gnang zhag mang mdzad long med na/ de nub nas dmigs pa 'dzugs pa'am/ nyi ma gcig gam gnyis rjes gnang mdzad nas dmigs pa 'dzugs pa sogs skabs dang bstun/ gang ltar yang snga dro'i lung mdzad lugs ni 'dra'o/ /chos spyod kyi lung rnams grub nas/ rje sa skya pa chen po'i rnam thar nas bzung ste bla ma brgyud pa rnams kyi rnam par thar pa'i lung ci 'gro mdzad pa phyag len yin/ grub na skabs 'dir thub pa dgongs gsal lta bu'i lung gnang na'ang legs/

sngags phyogs kyi yig cha'i lung ni gang yang snang gsum gyi skabs su mi mdzad pa phyag len yin/ bsngo ba zhu mi byung na/ chos rim tshar ma khad bsngo ba mdzad/ de nas rjes gnang yin na sems bskyed gsal 'debs la 'jug lung dang 'khrid yin na maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba yin/ yang chos thun gcig las mi mdzad na dgong chos kyi maṇ+ḍal yan grub nas thog mar lung ci rigs mdzad de rjes slar yang sems bskyed gsal 'debs nas brtsams te dmigs thun gnang bar mdzad do/ /gang ltar yang rung dmigs thun rnams dgong mo mdzad pa phyag len yin pas dgong mo chos rim rdzogs nas maṇ+ḍal phul/ chos rim rnams slob dpon mnyam du mdzad/ de nas zang zing med pa'i byams pa dang 'khor ba las sgrol 'dod kyi snying rje chen po dang ldan bzhin pas slob ma rnams la phan pa'i bsam pa dang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rgyas par 'dod pa'i bsam pas kun nas blangs te 'di skad brjod do/ /'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du sogs sems bskyed gsal 'debs dang / chos nyan pa'i kun spyod/ 'chad thabs khog phub sogs mgo rgyangs kyi bshad pa rnams gsung ngag bstan pa rgyas pa'i nyi 'od sogs chos 'byung rnams dang gsang ba'i sgo 'byed sogs bla ma brgyud pa rnams kyi gsung rab rtsa ba'i bla mas phyag len ji ltar mdzad pa sogs nges par byas la/ nyi ma dang po la de la gsan rgyu'i chos ni/ 'dir dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa sogs nas/ brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs gang rung gi lung sbyin pa'i bar dang / nyi ma gnyis par/ mgo rgyangs rgyas bsdus gang rung dang skabs 'gre/ dpyad don nyams len dang dmigs pa skyar tshul ni/ 'khrid gzhung ltar bshad nas/ de dag gis thos bsam gyi sgro 'dogs chod par byas nas/ gnyis pa bsgom pa nyams su blang tshul ni/ do nub nas brtsams te rang rang gi gnas khang du 'jam pa'i stan la bsam gtan gyi spyod lam gyis 'dug ste/

mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas sogs/ dmigs pa dmar btus tshar gcig skyar/ lan gsum skyor na yang / da dung lan gcig skyor na zhes sbyar te/ rang rang gi gnas khang sogs nas/ mnyam par bzhag go'i bar skyar tshul 'di ni thams cad la 'dra'o/ /'di man la sngar song gi sa bcad bskyar dgos sogs rnam dbye ma 'chol ba gal che/ dmigs thun rnams thun drug gam/ bzhi'am/ gsum mam/ tha na'ang do nub thun gcig dang sang snga dro thun gcig cis kyang nyams su len dgos/ de ltar ma byas na dmigs 'khrid thob pa'i go mi chod do/ /chos thun bsdu ba'i khrid dmigs gang yin de brjod nas de ring gi thugs dam de la mdzad par zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid/ /sogs dang / theg mchog dam chos rin chen bshad 'di la/ /bdag gis bsod nams mtha' yas gang thob pa/ /des ni 'gro kun theg mchog dam pa'i chos/ /rin chen dri ma med pa'i snod gyur te/ /bdud kyi sde dang mu stegs gzhung lugs dang / /chos ltar bcos pa'i mun sprul du ma dang / /gzhan yang 'gro ba'i nye bar 'tshe ba rnams/ /bdag gis stobs kyis rtsad nas 'joms gyur cig /srid pa thams cad du ni 'khor ba na/ /bsod nams ye shes dag ni mi zad brnyes/ /thabs dang shes rab ting 'dzin stobs dag dang / /yon tan ku gyis mi zad mdzod gyur cig /ces brjod/ slob ma rnams kyis/ theg mchog dam chos rin chen nyan 'di la/ /zhes sogs smon lam mnyam du mdzad/ snga dro'i lung la sems bskyed gsal btab nas/ de la gsan par bya rgyu'i chos ni zhes brjod la kha yig gang yin pa nas brtsams te lung mdzad/ 'jog mtshams tshig bkra legs pa zhig gi rdzogs mtshams su sleb nas de tsam la mdzad par zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs sngar bzhin bya'o/ /nyi ma dang po nyid la skyabs 'gro'i dmigs pa yang btang na/ nyi ma gnyis pa'i dmigs thun la/ grang dmyal/

nyi ma gsum pa la tsha dmyal/ nyi ma bzhi par nye 'khor ba dang nyi tshe ba/ nyi ma lnga par yi dwags dang dud 'gro'i sdug bsngal bsam/ 'di gnyis la nyi ma gnyis byas kyang chog nyi ma drug par/ 'gyur ba dang 'du byed kyi sdug bsngal 'di gnyis la'ang nyi ma gnyis byas na chog nyi ma bdun pa la/ dal 'byor mi lus rnyed par dka' ba bsam pa dang / rnyed pa'i lus rten phan 'dogs che ba bsam pa gnyis/ nyi ma brgyad par/ nges par 'chi ba bsam la rtag 'dzin spang ba/ nam 'chi nges med bsam la blo sna bstung ba/ chos med phan med bsam pa dam chos sgrub pa rnams 'di rnams la nyi ma gsum byas kyang legs/ nyi ma dgu par/ mi dge'i las 'bras bsam la spong 'dod bskyed pa dang / dge ba'i las 'bras bsam la sgrub 'dod bskyed pa'o/ /nyi ma bcu par/ lung ma bstan dge ba kha bsgyur ba'o/ /dge sdig lung ma bstan gsum nub gcig la btang yang legs/ nyi ma bcu gcig par/ gzhan la phan par 'dod pa'i byams pa bsgom pa/ nyi ma bcu gnyis par gzhan gyi sdug bsngal bsam 'dod snying rje bsgom pa/ nyi ma bcu gsum par/ gzhan phyir 'bras bu 'dod pa smon pa'i sems/ nyi ma bcu bzhi par/ bdag gzhan mnyam brje bsgom pa/ de dag gis spyod pa la bslab pa'o/ /nyi ma bco lnga par/ zhi gnas sgom pa/ nyi ma bcu drug pa la lhag mthong dang gzung 'brel/ nyi ma bcu bdun par/ skye 'gyur rnams la nges shes sgom pa dang / gsum pa spro ba bskyed pa dag pa'i snang ba'i 'khrid do/ /de gnyis song 'phral/ de ring gi thugs dam de la mdzad pa dang / sang nyin dbang gis sngon 'gro'i sems bskyed bya dgos pas/ de la dgos pa'i yo byad la sogs pa thogs med mdzad pa dang / mchod pa'i gdangs rnams do dgong bsgrig pa'i phyag srol 'dug pas de bzhin mdzad dgos byas la/ mchod yon phal cher ma'i gdangs deng sang bla med zer ba'i gdangs spyi 'gro de yin/ kun rig sogs yo ga dang mi gcig tshar gcig bsgrigs/

bsod nams 'di yis sogs dge ba bsngo'o/ /thun mong ma yin pa'i nyams snang dag snang gnyis la nyi ma re bya bar bshad pas/ de ltar spro na bshad pa dang dmigs thun rang rang gi skabs gnyis so sor phral la gnyis bya'o/ /'di dag gi bshad pa dang dmigs thun mang ba rnams kha sang gi de bshad pa'i skabs su lan cig skyar nas/ dmigs thun gyi skabs su ma bskyar yang chog pas skabs su gang babs bya'o/ /brgyud pa'i khyad par gnyis ldan gyi sems bskyed bya tshul la/ stegs shin tu mtho ba bang rim mang po dar zab kyis bkab pa'i steng ma'i dbus su mañdzi'i steng du gser dngul mkhar ba sogs kyis maṇ+ḍal la dri bzang gis thig le byas pa'i dbus dang phyogs bzhir tshom bu lnga bkod/ bang rim 'og ma rnams la me tog dkar po la sogs pa'i rdzas rnams btab pa'i mchod yon nam/ ma 'byor na chu gtsang ma ting phor bdun la sogs pa bshams/ de bzhin 'bru gtsang ma'i me tog tshar du bsgrigs pa la dri bzang po'i reng bu'i spos rgya dang / mar dkar gyi mar me'i phreng ba dang / bang rim 'og ma la zhal zas chung ngu dang chen po'i rim pa rgyan gyis spras pa ji ltar nus pa bshams shing / dkar gtor che ba gcig kyang bshams/ 'di dag gi rgyu cha ni phud phye dang dkar rgyan dkar me sogs khar sing gi nyin grwa pa la bskul ba dang / sbyin bdag bskul ba sogs kyi sgo nas rgyas par bya dgos te/ mchod pa dman pa dang / nyung na sems bskyed mi skye bar gsungs so/ /rol mo'i bye brag du ma dang / bla re dang / yol ba dang / 'phan dang / ba dan la sogs pa'i rgyan gyis bkod pa ji ltar mdzes pa nus pa bya'o/ /khri mtho zhing bzang ba'i steng du slob dpon yang chos gos rnams sbyar sogs rgyan gos bzang pos brgyan te bzhugs su gsol/ gaṇ+ḍe bskul la de nas 'tshogs tshar 'phral mdo gsum 'don/ slob ma rnams khrus byas te 'khod pa la/

slob dpon gyis/ 'o/ nyin dang mtshan mo sogs kyi nas/ sor chud pa'i stobs te/ de rnams dran bzhin pas ltung bshags bskul bar zhu/ byas la dbu mdzad pas sems can thams cad rtag par sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o zhes sogs dal bu tshar gsum 'don/ slob dpon rang nyid kyang khri las babs te stan dmar ram/ gding ba'i steng nas snam sbyar dang bcas te phyag bya/ slob ma rnams kyang phyag 'tshal du bzhugs/ de dag thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol zhes pa nas/ byang chub sems dpa' de dag rnams la bdag skyabs mchi/ zhes pa'i bar tsog pur thal mo sbyar te brjod/ mjug tu lus kyi las ni rnam pa gsum zhes sogs dang / thog ma med nas da lta'i bar sogs dang / 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dbang gis ni sogs phyag 'tshal ba dang sogs tshigs bcad rnams kyang sh+lo ka re re gsum gsum brjod/ slob dpon khri la 'khod nas chos rim gang la/ slob ma rnams la me tog bkye bsdu grub nas/ slob dpon gyi chos thams cad stong pa nyid du shes pa'i shes rab dang sems can bde ba la 'god par 'dod pa'i brtse ba dang / slob ma rnams la byang chub kyi sems bskyed par 'dod pa'i bsam pa bzang po dang ldan pas 'di skad brjod do/ /'o nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sogs nas/ bla ma la phyag 'tshal bar mos la bzhengs/ deng sang mi bzhengs pa 'dug nas phyag 'tshal zhing 'di'i rjes bzlos mdzod/ na mo gu ru sogs nas/ saṅgha ya/ de nas dbu mdzad pas/ mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa nas/ dge 'dun la'ang phyag 'tshal lo/ /skur gyur pa ni sogs sh+lo ka gcig phyag byar 'os pa sogs/ 'don zhing phyag bya'o/ /de nas sa la bsdad la slob dpon gyis mchod pa'i dmigs pa phog la/ mchod pa byin rlabs thun mong ba kun rig ltar mdzad par zhu byas la/ dbu mdzad kyis oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta sogs/ mchod yon phal che sogs brjod/ oṃ gu ru bud+dha sa twa maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ pra ti ts+tsha swā hā sogs sbyar/

rol mo'i gong du gdugs mchog phal cher phye phur phal cher/ rgyan phreng phal cher/ lda ldi phal cher bzhi la sngags med par tshigs bcad rkyang pa la gdangs mdzad pa mthong brgyud do/ /shap+ta'i tshe rol chen bya/ a badz+ra gaṇ+ḍi āḥzhes brjod cing dril bu gnas lngar dbul/ yang slob dpon gyis sprul pa'i mchod pa'i dmigs pa cung zad phog la/ gdugs rgyal mtshan/ ba dan bla bre rnams dang / kha zas sogs nas mchod par mos pa mdzod/ de las gzhan yang sogs nas gnas gyur cig ting shag sogs dang bcas ces dpon slob thams cad kyis brjod cing rol chen bya'o/ /gaṇ+ḍe ra ni'i sngags kyang brjod do/ /'gal rkyen sdig pa sbyang ba sogs nas dga' bar gyis shig ces pa'i bar dang / gsum pa gtang rag ni thog mar mchod pa'i phyir yan lag bdun pa bya ba la/ deng sang dbu mdzad gcig pu bzhengs te yan lag bdun pa bskul/ thams cad bzhengs la phyag 'tshal bar zhu/ dbu mdzad pas ji snyed su dag sogs brjod/ rol chen dang bcas pas/ na bza' dam pa sogs dang / sa la bsdad la thal mo sbyar te 'dod chags zhe sdang sogs nas/ byang chub phyir bsngo'o/ /zhes pa'i bar brjod/ dkar gtor chu gtsang gis bran la chos skyong rnams la gtor ma sbyin dgos pas sogs nas/ maṇ+ḍal phul zin pa dang / dge 'dun la dga' ston ci 'byor pa bya dgos pa ni/ mang ja zhig da lta yong ba yin/ de dag gi dge ba byang chub kyi mchog tu bsngo dgos pa yin pas/ phun sum tshogs pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyis sogs/ mthun 'gyur bskul la/ dbu zhwa phud/ bsngo smon rgyas par bya/ de ni dbang gi sngon du 'gro ba'i sems bskyed zhes bya ba yin/ dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba la/ zhal dang 'dra ba'i cho ga'i gzhi brgyad yod pa las/ thog mar slob ma rjes 'dzin byed dgos pa ni/ dgong mo'i dus su 'ong bas/ brda byung 'phral phebs par zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs bya'o/ /'di la rjes chog mi dgos/

snga dro nyi ma shar tsam na bya/ sbyin bdag bskul ba sogs byas la/ de'i nyin mang ja zhig cis kyang 'ong bar bya/ mang jar 'tshogs pa rnams kyis gsung 'don gyi rim pa mtshan brjod grub mtshams su slob dpon khri khar phebs/ zlum gtor gnyis dang chu bzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer mchod/ slob dpon gyi mdun du rdo rje dril bu nang mchod rnams bshams/ slob ma rjes 'dzin skabs su/ kye rdo rje'i bdag bskyed rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs pa bzlas pa dang bcas pa sngon du btang / de nas chos kyi gaṇ+ḍe bskul la/ slob ma rnams 'khrus dang phyag byas te mdun du 'khod pa la/ 'di skabs chos rim la/ sngon du yig brgya/ de nas snang gsum bzhi gyis chos rim byed pa'i bshad/ 'ga' zhig tu mchod gtor bshad kyang me dgos/ me tog bkye bsdu byas nas slob dpon gyis 'di skad brjod do/ /'o/ mdun du dul bar 'dug pa sogs nas/ gsang gnas nas rang gnas su 'khod par mos pa mdzod/ gtor ma la chab btang la/ cho ga shes pa thams cad kyis yi dam kye rdo rje dang mgon po lcam dral la gtor ma 'bul bar zhu byas la/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta nas/ kyai rdo rje dang / gur mgon lcam dral la phul/ hūm̐ yig ma dang / rgya klongs mas bstod/ dpal ldan mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa dang / /dpal ldan lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /phyi nang sogs kyi 'phrin las bcol/ yig brgya tshar gsum/ ma 'byor ba dang / rten yod na brtan bzhugs/ med na oṃ khyed kyi sogs dang / rang gi mig tu sogs dang / at+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes pa'i bar byas/ de na 'di skad brjod de/ kho bos ni lha mnyes par sogs nas/ 'dzem pa dang / dge ba'i bya ba la brtson par bya dgos/ de yang 'gal rkyen sdig pa sbyang ba sogs nas 'dus pas/ de gnyis nyams su blangs pa'i tshul la/ rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas dang maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba gnyis nyams su len dgos pas/ dang po rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas ni gnas dben par sogs rgyud gsum ltar brjod/

de ltar bsags sbyangs kyis rnal 'byor la 'bad par zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs brjod/ de nas rang nyid mtshams dam du byas la/ zhag bdun du bsnyen pa kha gso bya/ 'di skabs kyi bsnyen pa bum pa la brtan pa'ang 'dug de nas gza' skar bzang ba dang bstun la sta gon byas te rdul tshon gyis dkyil 'khor bzhengs la rgyu dbang bya'o/ /rgyu dbang thams cad la grub nas sngags lam mgo tshugs pa yin zhing / snga dro lung gis rim pa rnams bya zhing / dgong mo dmigs thun gtong ba yin pas sngags lam gyi skabs rnams su dgong chos tsho la bzhugs khri phebs bstun chos gan brdungs/ grwa pa snga ma 'ga' zhig 'tshogs pa dang bstun/ phyag 'phreng bsgrangs la bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ shrī badz+ra hā+e ru ka sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ zhes sogs yig brgya myur bar tshar nyer gcig mdzad/ de nas thal mo sbyar te/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste sogs nas byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa'i bar brjod/ chos 'don dang mdo sgrub bdud bzlog mi dgos/ dpal ldan lha mo sogs rnams rgyal gyi gzungs nas brtsams te/ khyod la bstod cing sogs/ 'phel bar mdzad du gsol gyi bar 'dra/ yon tan rgya mtsho ma tshar gnyis song tsam mam/ sde snod ma tshogs tsam nas mchod g.yog pa gcig gis maṇ+ḍal nas gtor/ gcig gis ka do ra khyer la bsdus nas maṇ+ḍal 'bul rgyur blug bsag sbyangs nyin ma gtogs nas 'gyed pa mi mdzad/ chos rim gzhan kha sang bzhin grub nas/ slob dpon gyis bskul la bsgrigs 'don mi dgos par 'ur 'don byas te/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyis mchog rnams la sogs tshar gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med bzhi tshar gcig oṃ shu n+ya ta dzñā na sogs thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i srung 'khor bsgom pa gzhan thams cad la mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ zhes pa'i bar brjod la/

skabs 'dir dmigs pa rnams bsgom la cung zad gcig bzhag de nas hūm̐ ring po byas nas/ na ma sa man+ta zhes sogs nyer cig 'gyogs se bzlas/ bha ya na tshar gsum/ rdo rje thal mo sbyar te/ su gang dag sogs/ lus bcings bar bgyi'o/ /ngag bcings bar bgyi'o/ /yid bcings bar bgyi'o la thal mo re re brdabs/ oṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ lan gsum gyi bar du 'ur 'don bya/ de nas bsgrigs 'don byas te/ hūm̐ ring po gsum brjod/ dang po'i tshe khams gsum snod bcud 'od du zhu nas srung ba'i 'khor lo la thim par bsam/ gnyis pa'i tshe/ thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i srung 'khor khro bo bcu la thim/ gsum pa'i tshe khro bcu rang gtsug tor 'khor lo bsgyur ba la thim par bsam/ yang bla ma 'ga' zhig dang po 'dra/ gnyis pa srung 'khor khro bo dang bcas pa rang la thim/ gsum pa rang nyid gtsug tor 'khor bsgyur du gsal gdab/ ces gsungs pas de gnyis gang rung bya'o/ /bsgrigs 'don byas la/ bgegs dang log par 'dren pa rnams/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir dpa' bo yis/ /shin tu gtum pa'i khro gzugs kyis/ /ma rung pa rnams tshar gcod shog /bsod nams 'di yis sogs sh+lau ka gcig bya/ 'di rnams slob dpon gyis bskul bar mdzad/ mchod g.yog pas chos gtor zlum gtor snying po pad 'dabs drug pa nang gtor snying la reg cing 'dab ma phan tshun thug pa dkar rgyan sgor mo gnyis pad 'dab mdun ma dang g.yas g.yon gyi gnyis rnams su rgyan yod pa slob dpon la zhal phyogs par stegs kyi steng du bzhag de'i 'khris su chab bum chung ngu chu gtsang bzhag par sngar bshams pa de nas chab btang la/ de nas slob dpon gyis oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho/ rnams phyag rgya dang bcas pa dang / oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum/ ha ho hriḥlan gsum brjod/ de dag sbrel nas lan gsum brjod kyang chog hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya byas la/ oṃ ma hā bhu ta sa pa ri wā ra a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥzhes pas mgron bkug

pad skor dang bcas pas rdo rje thal mo kha phye la/ oṃ in+t+ra dza ma sogs gtor sngags lan gsum/ phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs/ oṃ ma hā bhu ta sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi nang mchod phul bar bsam rdo rje thal mo sbyar te/ dkar mo ri dgas sogs/ mi bskyod rdo rje sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces pa'i bar brjod/ mtheb srin gyi se gol dang / oṃ badz+ra muḥzhes brjod/ gong gi bsod nams 'di yis sogs tshar ma khad/ mchod g.yog pas/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu zhes bskul la/ chu dang bcas te maṇ+ḍal sum cu so bdun ma 'ur 'don byas te 'bul/ deng sang ni de las mi mdzad/ glo bo mkhan chen pas mdzad pa'i tho yig na tshom bu bdun ma lan gnyis dang / so bdun ma lan gcig 'phul ba sngags lam gyi skabs kyi dmigs pa'i dus thams cad du mdzad pa phyag len la yod gsungs pa 'dug pas de bzhin grub na bya/ de nas mchod g.yog pas bsgrigs 'don byas te 'bul la/ gang gis chod rdzas la/ deng nas byang chub sogs tshigs rkang lnga pa tshigs bcad gnyis byas la/ bzhes nas byin gyi rlabs tu gsol/ zhes pa dang phyag byas la 'dug go /'di dag la gdangs mi mdzad do/ /'di dag dgong mo'am snga dro gang rung dmigs pa gtong na'ang dgos shing / snga dro dpe lung rgyas par mdzad pa la/ snang gsum dus kyi ji lta ba bzhin mdzad do/ /sngags lam gyi skabs su lung la/ dbang chu chen mo slob dpon rin po ches mdzad pa/ rtsa ltung 'khrul spong rje btsun gyis mdzad pa/ sgrub thabs yan lag bzhi pa rje btsun rtse mos mdzad pa/ yan lag drug pa'i tho rje btsun gyis mdzad pa/ rdo rje bdag med ma'i sgrub thabs rje btsun gyis mdzad pa/ las bzhi'i sbyin sreg rje btsun gyis mdzad pa/ tshogs 'khor rje btsun gyis mdzad pa rnams kyi lung bya/ dgong mo'am snga dro gang ltar yang dmigs thun gyi sngon la lung cung zad gtong na/

maṇ+ḍal dang gang gis mchod rdzas ma tshar nas/ sems bskyed gsal 'debs byas la lung cung zad bya/ de nas sems bskyed gsal 'debs nas brtsams te dmigs thun gtang bas/ bla mas mchod gtor bya ba dang / slob ma rnams kyis maṇ+ḍal dang gang gis mchod rdzas ma bya ba dus gcig la bya ba yin no/ /sngags lam nyin dang po la/ 'o nam mkha'i mtha' dang sogs de'i ched du rdo rje theg pa'i dam pa'i chos zab mo sogs/ sngags lugs kyi chos nyan pa'i kun spyod gsal btab/ de la 'dir gsan par bya rgyu'i chos ni 'dir dus gsum gyis sogs nas/ sngon 'gro snang ba gsum gyis sgo nas dkri ba dang / dngos gzhi rgyud gsum gyi sgo nas dkri ba gnyis las/ dang po sngon 'gro snang ba gsum gyi sgo nas dkri ba'i 'khrid kyi rim pa rnams sngon du song nas/ da gnyis pa nyams len gyi dngos gzhi rgyud gsum gyi sgo nas dkri ba la rje btsun rin po che sogs dang / bsag sbyangs maṇ+ḍal dang yig brgya'i rnal 'byor btang / nyi ma gnyis pa la sems bskyed gsal 'debs 'dra/ dmigs pa kha sang song ba skyar tshul yang 'dra/ de bzhin 'og ma thams cad la yang shes par bya'o/ /sa skya pa chen pos gsungs so'i bar 'dra/ de ring gi thugs dam sogs 'dra/ nyi ma gsum pa la/ lhan cig skyes pa'i chos gsum gyis sgo nas 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi blta ba bsgom pa/ nyi ma bzhi par nyams su blangs pa'i gnad gsum gyi sgo nas rgyas par bshad pa dang rmi lam gyi dpe/ nyi ma lnga par dpe lhag ma rnams dmigs rkang gcig la btang ba'i dbang du byas pa/ nyi ma drug par/ gnyis pa sems snang sgyur mar bsgrub pa'i dpe brgyad/ nyi ma bdun par/ gsum pa sgyur ma rang bzhin med par sgrub pa/ nyi ma brgyad par/ gnyis pa brjod bral du sgrub la/ nyi ma dgu par slar yang rtogs pa gsal ba'i phyir dpe'i gtso bo bzhi btus pa/ nyi ma bcu par gsum pa rgyud gsum gyi sgo nas rgyas bar bshad pa ni yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bu'i rtsa 'grel las 'byung ba yin no/

/sogs kyi thos bsam gyi sgro 'dogs bcad nas/ bsgom pas nyams su len pa la sbyor ba'i chos gsum sogs dang / gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i chos gsum ni/ gsal bar thag bcad/ stong par rgyas btab/ zung 'jug tu la 'da' ba gsum la mnyam par bzhag pa sogs dang / 'di'i skabs su snga dro'am phyi dro gang rung la 'khor 'das dbyer med rtsa 'grel gyis lung byas nas/ brda' sprod par bya/ 'di la rgyud gsum mdzes rgyan du dmigs par dril nas nyams su len tshul gyi gsal kha ma mdzad la/ rje btsun rin po ches lhan cig skyes pa'i chos gsum gyis skabs su gsungs pa de dmigs pa 'og ma rnams kyi gzhir bya rgyu yin par de'i nyams len dang cha 'dra bar dmigs pa bya dgos/ dmigs thun ma byas pa lung la brten na yang don 'grub pas skabs su phyag len bzhin mdzod/ phyi bskyed pa'i rim pa la sngon 'gro bsags sbyangs nub gcig byas la/ dngos gzhi nyi ma brgyad du mdzad pa phyag len rgyas pa yin pas/ de'i rim pa bzhin brjod na/ nyi ma dang po la me tog bkye bsdu yang bya/ sems bskyed gsal 'debs nas brtsams te blta ba'i sa bcad rnams bskyar nas/ spyi don gnyis pa lam gyi nyams bskyed pa'i phyir sogs dang sbrel nas bsag sbyangs kyi dmigs pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang bcas pa 'bogs bsag sbyangs 'jug gsum nyams su len pa ni bskyed rim gyi sngon 'gro yin pas/ de ring gi sogs/ dngos gzhi nyi ma brgyad du byed na/ nyi ma dang po la/ mngon rtogs kyi sngon 'gro rnam gsum gyi go don bshad nas/ de dag gi thun mong gi sngon 'gro gsum gyi rnam bzhag bstan zin la/ mngon rtogs kyi go don lhag ma rnams sang nyin nas rim par zhu bas/ de dag gis thos bsam sogs nas spyod lam dang ldan pas bsdad la/ 'jug pa'i rim pa ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sogs nas/ spyan gsum khro gnyer shangs dang bcas pa'i go don brda sprad/

thun thams cad la 'jug gnas ldang sogs 'dra/ nyi ma gnyis pa la/ thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro la gsum/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa/ ༞ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa gsum las/ tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i go don bshad nas sems 'dzin gyi dmigs pa la/ nyi ma gnyis pa la thun bzhir byas pa'i thun dang po la sngar gyi steng du zhal gyi sgor mche ba'i sogs/ g.yas zhal dkar ba'i bar gyi go don/ bskyed rim gyi dmigs pa nyi ma gnyis pa la/ srung 'khor gyi go don skabs gnad lnga ni/ gtso bo 'pho ba'i gnad dang / bsrung bya sba ba'i gnad dang / lha'i rnam pa'i gnad dang / 'khor lo 'khor ba'i gnad/ sngags kyis gnad dang lnga sogs/ sems 'dzin g.yon zhal dmar ba nas steng zhal gyi bar zhal brgyad so so la sems 'dzin pa ste/ steng zhal dud kha ste/ mar me mdzad kyis steng zhal g.yu mdog ces gsungs pa ltar/ du ba sngo legs sam/ g.yu gru dkar gyi mdog lta bu/ steng zhal 'di la dbu'i gtsug tor sor bzhi pa'o/ /khro gnyer rnams ni spyan gsum 'dzoms pa'i shangs kyi steng du khro gnyer rim pa gsum mo/ /bskyed rim gyi dmigs pa nyi ma bzhi pa/ sems bskyed gsal 'debs nas/ slar yang 'khor lo g.yas su 'khor ba bsam mo'i bar bskyar/ sngon 'gro rnams song nas/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la yan lag drug sogs nas/ gzhal yas khang bskyed pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi yan lag nī la ya badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ gi bar gyis go don rnams brda sprad/ de'i rkyen gyi yan lag gi skabs/ oṃ dkar po/ āḥdamar po/ hūm̐ sngon po rnams gong 'og tu brtsegs par gnas pa la steng nas hoḥdamar po mgo thur bstan dang / 'og tu hoḥdamar po mgo gyen gyis bar du chud par/ lha mo rnams kyi ro gdan mgo g.yon du bstan pa/ sems 'dzin gyi dmigs pa nyi ma bzhi pa la thun bzhir byas pa'i sogs nas/ shal brgyad mgrin pa de dag gi rgyan sku byings rnams la sems 'dzin/

bskyed rim gyi dmigs pa nyi ma lnga pa la/ gnyis pa rjes su chags pa rdo rje sems dpa'i yan lag la gsum/ dam tshig pa bskyed pa/ mig sogs byin gyis brlabs pa/ ye shes pa zhugs pa sogs nas/ 'bras bu'i rdo rje 'dzin pa'i skabs kyi gar dgu'i bar gyi go don/ sems 'dzin la nyi ma lnga pa la thun bzhir sogs nas yab yum me ri dang bcas pa la sems 'dzin/ bskyed rim gyi dmigs pa nyi ma drug pa la/ gsum pa bzhengs nas snod bcud sbyangs pa nas/ bstod pa rin chen 'byung ldan gyis yan lags gis bar gyi go don/ sems 'dzin nyi ma drug pa la thun bzhir sogs nas/ gtso bo yab yum phyogs kyi lha mo bzhi dang bcas par sems 'dzin/ bskyed rim gyi dmigs pa nyi ma bdun pa la/ de ltar dngos gzhi yan lag drug gis rnal 'byor rnams sogs nas/ bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor la gnyis te sogs nas/ ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gyi bar gyi go don/ gtso bo yab yum ni sta gon dang sbyin sreg la sogs pa'i dus he ru ka'i phyag gnyis pa'i bar bsdu ba'ang yod la/ gzhan rang gtso bo yab yum ni nyal ba'i rnal 'byor gyi bar mi bsdu bar mdzad do/ /sems 'dzin ni nyi ma bdun pa la thun bzhir sogs nas lha dgu la sems 'dzin/ bskyed rim gyi dmigs pa nyi ma brgyad pa la/ sbyang gzhi sbyong byed ngo sprad/ sbyang gzhi sbyang tshul gal che bas da dung lan gcig bskur/ sems 'dzin nyi ma brgyad pa la thun bzhir sogs nas snod bcud thams cad dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo gsal btab cing sems 'dzin de ltar ma byung na yang ci rigs par sems 'dzin de dag gi 'jug gnas ldang gsum gyi sgo nas rten gzhal yas khang srung 'khor dur khrod dang bcas pa dang / snod bcud dkyil 'khor 'khor lor gsal ba la sems bzung ba de la de ring gi thugs dam gyi rim pa gnang ba dang / sang nas lus dkyil nyams su len pa'i sngon 'gro lam dus kyi dbang bskur bya dgos pas de bzhin dgongs par bzhugs pa zhu/

bsod nams 'di yis sogs/ 'di ni bskyed rim gyi sems 'dzin rgyas pa yin la/ bsdu na nyi ma gsum la mdzad pa ni/ gong 'og thams cad snga ma dang 'dra ba las nyi ma dang po'i thun bzhir byas pa'i dang po la spyan dbus ma/ gnyis pa la spyan gsum ka gsum pa la dbu ril po/ bzhi pa la sku ril po la sems 'dzin/ nyi ma gnyis pa'i thun dang po la yum dang gdan/ gnyis pa la gtso 'khor tshang ma/ gsum pa la gzhal yas khang / bzhi pa la dur khrod srung 'khor dang bcas pa la sems bzung / nyi ma gsum pa'i thun dang po la/ phyi rol gyi dngos po gang rung gcig dkyil 'khor du bsgom/ gnyis pa la rang gi mthong tshad kyi snang ba dkyil 'khor du bsgom/ gsum pa la rang gi bsgom pa'i dkyil 'khor rgya bskyed de 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad khyab par bsgom/ bzhi pa la lha dang dkyil 'khor chung ngur bsdus la/ yungs 'bru'i tshad tsam gyi dkyil 'khor gyis nam mkha'i khams thams cad khyab ste yungs 'bru cher ma song zhing nam mkha' cher ma song ba'i tshul du bsgom pa ni chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa'i gsung rab kyis dgongs pa'o/ /phyi nang sems 'dzin gnyis kyi bar du lam dus kyi dbang mdzad pa yin no/ /lus dkyil gyi dmigs pa nyi ma dang po la/ sems bskyed gsal 'debs nas brtsams te phyi bskyed pa'i rim pa dang / nang bskyed pa'i rim pa gnyis las zhes pa'i bar gyi phyi bskyed rim gyi skabs bzhin bskyar la/ dang po phyi bskyed pa'i rim pa la sems 'dzin pa'i tshul rnams sngon du legs par song zin nas/ gnyis pa nang bskyed pa'i rim pa nyams su blangs pa'i tshul la/ thog mar thabs rgyud kyi gtso bo lam dus kyi dbang bla ma las blangs dgos pa ni/ rang nyid kyis rgyu dus kyi dbang bskur ba thob pa'i bla ma de nyid kyis rdo rje lus kyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs te blangs grub pa yin/ lus dkyil gyis sems 'dzin la/

'jug rim ye shes pa bstim pa'i rkyen gyis/ lus dkyil gsal btab nas/ bstod pa rin 'byung gi yan lag gi bar tshar ba dang / phyi dkyil la sems cung zad 'dzin tsam sngon du 'gro bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa gnas pa'i rim pa ni/ thog mar rang gi phung po dang sogs nas drag tu bya'i bar dang / des nas rten lus dkyil la sems 'dzin pa'i tshul ni/ spyi bo'i pags pa'i 'og gi sha rus chu rgyus dang bcas pa gnas de nyid du sna tshogs rdo rje shar dkar dpral ba ngos su bstan pa sogs/ lte ba sngon po gru bzhi/ de bzhin du rkang mthil g.yas g.yon gyi lpags pa'i steng gi sha rus chu rgyus dang bcas pa gnas de nyid du rdo rje sngon po che chung du ma bdal ba'i sa gzhir ro/ /rtsibs ma ring thung thams cad gnas de nyid du tshad de nyid kyi rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa gcig la gcig 'brel ba'i rwa ba sha ba'i rwa brkyangs pa lta bu sogs/ sbyang gzhi gang na gnas pa de nyid rgyur byas nas rten dang brten pa'i rnam par bsgom/ 'gos/ mar do/ mal jo/ bde mchog kha che lugs sogs kyi dod dam tshang rtse yang 'dir rnam par bsgyur ba nag po pa'i sdom par bshad par/ rkang pa'i mthil du rtsom chen sogs dang / rje'i lū hi pa'i gsal byed du'ang bshad gsungs/ chos rje glo bo mkhan chen pa'i tho yig tu gtso bo dkyil krung du bshad/ mā ma ki brgyad g.yon brkyangs/ 'di dag la ro gdan sogs med par bsgom/ bkrag cing 'od 'bar ba dmigs pa gsal che tshad gnas yangs dog gi dbye'o/ /nyi ma dang po brtan lus dkyil dang thugs kha'i pho brang gi go don dang sems 'dzin/ lus dkyil gyi nyi ma gnyis pa la/ mgrin pa spyi bo lte ba ste pho brang bar pa gsum gyis go don dang sems 'dzin no/ /rin 'byung 'khor lo la rin po che'i rgyan yang lhag por yod pa ga ya dha ra'i gzigs snang yin par gsungs la/ rus rgyan gyis skabs su rin po ches spel bar gsungs so/

/lus dkyil nyi ma gsum pa la/ gsang gnas kyi 'khor lo'i go don sems 'dzin rang rig pa'i dag pa mthar phyin pa yin no'i bar dang / yan lag gi lha rnams la sems 'dzin tshul ni/ mig 'bras gnyis kyi nang na gzugs la 'jug pa'i rten du gyur pa'i rtsa gnas pa de nyid mig tu gti mug rdo rje sogs rtsa nang de nas gzugs la 'jug pa'i rtogs pa bskul bar byed pa'i rlung gnas pa de nyid gau rī sogs yul gyi yul gyi lha rnams kha dog nag por 'byung bar yul rang ngos nas bya byed kyi spros pa dang bral ba mtshon lha yul gyi lha rnams kha dog nag po zhal nang du gzigs te de ltar zhal sprad do/ /khro bcu ni/ lag pa'i skabs lag pa'i mkhrig ma la la 'dod/ la la lag pa'i rtsa ba ste gru mo dang dpung lhu 'brel mtshams su 'dod de dpyad/ phyi ma dag gam snyam mo/ /lce dkyil gyi rgyab tsam rtse mo phyogs su pad mthar ro/ /gsang gnas rdo rje'i dkyil du bgegs mthar gzhan sla spyi gtsug lpags 'og rus steng 'khor bsgyur/ rkang mthil rdo rje'i sa gzhi'i steng du rlung dkyil 'og gnod mdzes/ khro bo rnams zhal nang gzigs/ pho brang rnam dang yan lag gi lha sogs sde tshan re re bzhin yang lha de thams cad kyang sku'i dbyibs sogs nas ngo bo nyid kyi sku'o/ /zhes sems bzung / gsal na gsal te 'phro sogs dang / 'jug nas ldang gsum thams cad la 'dra'o/ /bum dbang gi lta ba dang 'da' kha ma sogs la nyin gcig spro na'o/ /don dmar btus tsam las rgyud gsum mdzes rgyan gyi tshig ris sgra ji bzhin pa ma lcogs na/ de dag rgyas par shes par bya ba'i phyir lung la brten nas rung bas 'di ltar shes par bya'o/ /zhes mtshams sbyar la rgyud gsum mdzes rgyan nas 'byung ba'i lta ba ngo bo nyid gsum sogs kyi lung dal bur blang la go bar ngo sprad pas rung ngo / /'di rnams da lta dmigs rim du nyams su blangs kyang rung bas de la de ring gi thugs dam sogs/

de yang chad kyi bum dbang gi lam sogs zhar byung dang bcas pa sogs nas rgyas par na skabs 'dir bdag med ma'i dbang dang byin rlabs gnyis ka bya/ yang na yum gyi byin rlabs tsam bya/ dus rgyun par ni ma byas kyang rung / gsang dbang gi 'khrid la dmigs pa rgyas par ltar na dngos gzhi nyi shu rtsa lnga/ sngon 'gro la yang zhag grangs ci rigs par mdzad pa yin kyang / de tsam mi 'grub pas nyung ba'i dbang du byas te nyi ma dang po la maṇ+ḍal gyi nas bkye bsdu grub nas/ sems bskyed gsal 'debs nas/ sprul pa'i sku rang bzhin lhun grub kyi bar bskyed rim gyi mgo brkyangs rnams sngar bzhin las/ de rnams sngon du song zin nas/ gnyis pa gsang dbang dang rjes su sogs dang bsag sbyang gnyis sogs/ nyi ma gnyis pa la/ me tog nas 'gyed mi dgos/ bsam gtan gyi yan lag dgu'i skabs su bsgom pa gsum rgyas bsdus gnyis las rgyas pa kyai rdo rje'i phyi nang sbrags ma'i mngon rtogs/ bsdus pa byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa/ spyi bor bla ma bsgom pa/ rang yi dam gyi lhar bsgom pa rnams 'khor 'das dbyer med skabs ltar bshad/ rdor bzlas kyi dmigs pa phab/ nyi ma gsum pa la/ phyir btang ba nas kha sbyor gyi bar gyi rlung sbyor lhag ma drug po bstan/ nyi ma bzhi pa la/ gtum mo'i dmigs pa 'khor lo la ma bsten pa lnga las/ mar me bso ba/ tshangs pa'i thog rtsa ba'i rnal 'byor/ bsrub shing gi 'khor lo rnams so/ /nyi ma lnga pa la/ lnga pa thig le'i rnal 'byor ma/ snying ga'i nyi zla kha sbyor nas mdzod spu skra dkar sa bon gyi bar bzhi dang / spyi don gnyis pa 'khor lo la brten pa gsum las/ 'khor lo gcig la brten pa rno/ gnyis la brten pa myur zhes pa'o/ /nyi ma drug pa la/ 'khor lo bzhi la brten pa 'di'i dbyangs gsal sogs yig 'bru rnams so sor brjod dgos so/ /'di dus rgyun du nyams su len rgyu yin pas/

blo la 'dzin par bya dgos pas len gsum bskyar/ nyin bdun pa la/ spyi don gsum pa man ngag gi gnad la brten pa'i myur ba la/ me dmar skya la dmigs pa sogs me dmigs bdun bstan/ nyi ma brgyad pa la/ lta ba sogs bstan/ de dag kyang rgyud gsum mdzes rgyan tshig sgros ma nyams pa yod na des mchog dmigs pa dmar btus tsam las thams cad blo la mi lcogs na gsang dbang gi skabs kyi rgyud gsum mdzes rgyan gyi lung zhig byas na'ang legs te gegs sel la sogs pa'i man ngag phal che re re 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ /shes rab ye shes kyi lam la/ nyi ma dang po la maṇ+ḍal gyi nas bkye bsdu grub nas/ sems bskyed gsal 'debs nas/ drug drug gis gtan la 'bebs pa las bum dbang gi lam bskyed pa'i sogs nas/ longs spyod rdzogs sku rang bzhin lhun grub ste drug go /zhes ba'i bar gyi sa bcad bskyar/ de rnams sngon du legs par song nas/ spyi don gsum pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang dang / rjes su 'brel ba la sogs nas bsag sbyangs phab/ nyi ma gnyis pa la thun gyi sngon 'gro bsam gtan gyi yan lag dgu ni gsang dbang dang 'dra/ srog rtsol mi dgos gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ lam rgyas pa dang / bsdus pa gnyis las sogs/ lam rgyas pa btang / chos gos 'dzin pa rnams kyis kyang re shig ye rgya labya rung bar bshad gsungs/ nyi ma gsum pa la/ lam bsdus pa dang / gnyis pa lam de bsgom pa las byung ba'i lta ba sogs bstan/ nyi ma bzhi pa la dbang bzhi pa'i lam gyi dmigs pa ni/ me tog bkye bsdu mi dgos/ mgo brkyangs 'bras bus chos kyi sku rang bzhin lhun grub kyi sa bcad rnams bskyar/ de rnams kyi bsgom rim rnam sngon du song nas/ dbang bzhi pa dang rjes su 'brel ba la sogs rba rlabs gsum brtan/ nyi ma lnga pa las/ lta ba sogs nas ngo bo nyid kyi sku rang bzhin lhun grub ni 'bras bu'i skabs nyid du 'chad par 'gyur bas 'dir ma spros so/

/de dag gi lus thabs rgyud la dbang bzhis dang rjes su 'brel ba'i lam bsgom pa'i tshul rnams song nas/ gsum pa 'bras bu sku lnga sogs 'bras bu la spro ba bsgom pa'i dmigs thun yang bskyar ba dang bcas pa dang / spyi don gsum pa nges shes khyad par can bskyed la sogs kyi sa mtshams dang / 'bras bu mthun 'jug bshad/ de yang sa mtshams rnam par bzhag pa ni 'khor lo 'tsham skor gnyis las tshogs sbyor mtshams/ mthong lam yan bskor ba'o/ /'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi sa'i rnam par bzhag pa ni/ rig ma'i skyes bu'am/ bcu gsum pa'i sangs rgyas/ de ni rgyu la ltos dgos pas de skad do/ /rgyas par gzhung bshad rnams dang ljon shing sogs su shes/ 'dir rgyas par mi gsung / gsum pa nyams len pa'i rnal 'byor pa la gsang ba bcus rgyas gdab cing skal ldan gyi slob ma la phan par gdams pa ni/ thog mar/ bla ma'i mdzad spyod gsang zhes bya ba la sogs pas rgyas btab ci nus la bab cing rten 'brel 'grig pa'i tshe spel bar gdams pa'o/ /gsum pa bsgrub pa mthar phyin nas gzhan don bya ba'i tshul ni/ rang don sgrub pa'i lung sbyin pa/ gzhan don bshad pa'i lung sbyin pa gnyis kyi sgo nas shes par bya ba yin no/ /de dag gis gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdams dag gi gzhung shing rgyas pa gzhung ji lta ba bzhin du dkri ba'i gzhung shing gi dmigs rim rnams yongs su rdzogs par grub pa yin/ de ltar 'o skol rnams kyi bshad bsgrub byas pa la dge ba dpag tu med pa yod pas dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag bar ma dor chud mi za ba'i phyir du bsngo bas rgyas 'debs dgos pas/ phun sum tshogs pa'i dge 'dun sogs nas/ 'dogs par zhu/ zhes sogs brjod cing zhwa phud la bsngo ba rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs par bya/ mjug tu spyi bsngo rgyas par byas la/ mthun 'gyur gyi tshigs bcad thung ba rnams mi bya bar/

'gro la bde skyid ma tshar gcig dal bus bskul/ mjug tu bstan pa'i bdag po dpal ldan sa skya pa sogs brjod la/ bstan pa yun ring gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /ces brjod la grol lo/ /thog mar 'khrid kyi skabs su dmigs rkang ma chag tsam nyams su len pa yin la/ phyis mthun rkyen 'tshogs nas sgrub pa nyams su len tshe dmigs pa snga ma nyams ma skyes par phyi mar mi spo/ dmigs rim yongs rdzogs ther chags su nyams su blang ngo / /'khrid grol nas/ de'i dgong mo lta bu'am/ sang sogs skabs gang bder/ lam zab kyi bsag sbyangs tshogs pa la phyogs gcig tu bya/ de nas lam zab nyer lngas tshan pa la rim bzhin bya zhing / chags med gzhan rnams kyang skabs su gang babs la byas te chag med kyi rnal 'byor la brtson par gyis zhes nan tan du gdams par bya/ sngar gyi dbang chu la sogs pa'i lung rnams grub nas/ bskyed rim phyi nang gi skabs su rje sangs rgyas rin chen pas mdzad pa'i bskyed rim gyi bshad pa'i lung mdzad la/ lus dkyil gyi bshad pa'i tshe kun mkhyen rin po ches mdzad pa'i lus dkyil gyi rnam bshad/ bde chen bcud kyi snying po'i lung bya/ de nas lam 'bras glegs bam gyi lung bya/ cha lag rnams rdzogs pa'i slob ma la pu ti dmar bsdus kyi lung dang / sras don ma la sogs pa'i gzhung bshad gzhan gyi lung yang sbyin no/ /'di dag ni sngar bshad pa'i yig cha rnams dang / 'khrid kyi dngos gzhi snang gsum mdzes rgyan/ rgyud gsum mdzes rgyan/ rgyud pa'i khyad par gnyis ldan gyi sems bskyed/ slob ma rjes bzung gi yi ge dbang bshad rgyas bsdus/ mngon dkyil mdzes rgyan rnams te/ snyigs ma'i dus 'dir chos 'dis rtsa lag thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyi yig cha gzhir gzhag gi phyag len mtshams sbyor gyi tho yin la/ rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum gyi rnam gzhag kyang mdzes rgyan gnyis na gsal/

de ltar gsung rab kyi go don la dpyod nus med pa dag gis khrid kyi dmigs rkang dmar btus rje dbang ngag brtan pa'i rdo rjes nag po 'gro shes su bkod pa der gzigs/ 'dir ni gong du smos pa'i yig cha rnams nub kyi dogs nas nag po 'gro shes ma byas par lag len gyi tho rags pa tsam yin la/ da dung phyag len 'gros 'dir ma bkod pa don thob blo la nges shes 'char rgyu mang po yod cing / chos 'di yi ge rkyang pas go ba'i chos min cing / bla ma brgyud pa'i dam tshig la sel med pa dang / bla ma rnams mnyes pa'i gsung rgyun dang mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len rnams gal che'o/ /zhes gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i khrid kyi tho yig gnad kyi lde mig ces pa 'di ni lugs 'di'i chos skor la 'dris par sbyangs pa dge slong sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis shrī e waṃ chos ldan gyi gtsug lag khang du bsdebs pa dge legs 'phel// //smras pa/ sngon tshe bstan 'gro'i dge ba yar ldan dus/ /don gnyer skye bo chos don sems pas brel/ /chos phyir lus srog longs spyod gtong ba la/ /pad mtshor ngang pa 'jug 'dra e ma mtshar/ /deng dus skye bo tshe 'di'i stobs 'byor las/ /gsung rab gnad la sems pa nyin skar tsam/ /cung zad yod tsho mthun rkyen ri bong rwa/ /'di 'dra bsam na 'dis kyang gzhan don ci/ /'on kyang rang la grub pa dngos po'i gshis/ /phyi rol yul snang me long la 'char ba/ /rten 'brel chos nyid su yis dgag par nus/ /de phyir 'di yang ngang tshul bsgom pa'i shugs/ /'dis mtshon dge tshogs ma lus gcig bsdus pas/ /gru 'dzin gnas su myur 'pho mngon shes dang / /snying stobs chen pos rgyal sras mthu thob nas/ /chos 'di'i 'dzin skyong spel ba'i byed por shog/ //sa ma ya i thi/ bkra shis dge'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ gsung ngag lam 'bras kyi khrid 'chad par tho yig
